subject.title: Feature Request: Support multiple OpenCode Go workspaces under a single account

question: Should implementation begin with deterministic workspace-identifier labels, or wait until a redacted authenticated capture proves a stable display-name field?
rationale: The product architecture is accepted, but current discovery proves only identifiers and repository policy avoids unrequested live credential probes.

options.title: Start with identifier labels
options.body: Implement the accepted fan-out with deterministic safe identifier labels and add display names after their response contract is proven.

options.title: Wait for name proof
options.body: Hold implementation until a contributor supplies a redacted authenticated multi-workspace response demonstrating a stable display-name field.

recommendation.title: Start with identifier labels
recommendation.body: Implement the accepted fan-out with deterministic safe identifier labels and add display names after their response contract is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the accepted architecture and is best positioned to decide whether identifier-only labels satisfy the first-release boundary.
